morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为度量单位记忆。按输入包 DBP 的 éla，首元音采用 /e/，不采用提示中的 /ə/；e.la 为据标准读音补出的分音节。

senses.zh_definition: 码：英制长度单位，等于三英尺或三十六英寸，即精确的 0.9144 米。
senses.en_definition: A yard: a unit of length equal to three feet, thirty-six inches, or exactly 0.9144 metres.
senses.ms_definition: Ukuran panjang yang sama dengan 36 inci atau kira-kira 91 sentimeter.
senses.nuances: 输入包的《Kamus Dewan》释义将其约写为 91 厘米；精确换算为 91.44 厘米。常见于布料买卖，须区分一码与一米。此处收单位义，不把提示中的 hela 变体义混入。单位义、精确换算及相关形式可参见 [ela 词条](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/ela#Malay)。

dual_scenarios.context: 采购说明 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pembekal menawarkan kain pada harga RM20 bagi setiap ela.
dual_scenarios.zh: 供应商的布料报价为每码二十令吉。
dual_scenarios.en: The supplier is offering the fabric at RM20 per yard.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kak, kain ni berapa ringgit satu ela? Saya nak tiga ela je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kak, berapakah harga kain ini bagi setiap ela? Saya mahu tiga ela sahaja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 姐，这布一码多少钱？我要三码就好。
dual_scenarios.en: Hi, how much is this fabric per yard? I’d like just three yards.
spoken_features: kak 是对较年长女性常用的亲切称呼
nak 对应 mahu，je 对应 sahaja
satu ela 是口语中自然的单位表达

messages.speaker: Farah (顾客)
messages.ms_spoken: Kak, kain ni berapa ringgit satu ela? Saya nak tiga ela je.
messages.ms_standard: Kak, berapakah harga kain ini bagi setiap ela? Saya mahu tiga ela sahaja.
messages.zh: 姐，这布一码多少钱？我要三码就好。
messages.en: Hi, how much is this fabric per yard? I’d like just three yards.

messages.speaker: Kak Aina (布店店员)
messages.ms_spoken: Satu ela dua puluh ringgit, dik. Nak saya potong sekarang?
messages.ms_standard: Harganya dua puluh ringgit bagi setiap ela. Adakah adik mahu saya memotongnya sekarang?
messages.zh: 一码二十令吉，妹子。要我现在裁吗？
messages.en: It’s twenty ringgit a yard. Would you like me to cut it now?

etymology.historical_story: Ela connects everyday fabric shopping with the history of imported measures. Its name has been linked to English ell or Dutch el, although its modern dictionary meaning is the yard. The useful distinction is between a word’s proposed ancestry and its present measurement: when a seller quotes an ela today, the intended unit here is thirty-six inches. [Etymology and meaning](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/ela#Malay).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象店员把布“诶，拉”开一码：ela＝码；一声口令记住 36 英寸＝91.44 厘米。谐音只作记忆提示。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 向店员询价可用 Berapakah harga seela?；熟悉的社区布店可酌用 kak 或 abang，正式交易用 encik 或 puan。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 裁布前确认按 ela 还是 meter 计价，并说明长度、幅宽及总价。已经裁下的布料不宜默认可以随意退换。
